Class CardController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.GUI.Controllers.Board.CardController
public class CardController extends Object
Controller for a single card slot on the game board. Handles rendering, interactivity and visual effects for one card, delegating image rendering to CardView and effects to UIEffects.

    • setInteractable

      public void setInteractable(boolean enabled)
      Enables or disables interactivity for this card slot. When disabled, all mouse events are ignored and any active effect is reset.
      Parameters:
      enabled - true to make this card interactable, false to disable it

    • getDTO

      public CardDTO getDTO()
      Returns the card DTO currently displayed in this slot.
      Returns:
      the current CardDTO

    • handleCardClick

      private void handleCardClick()
      Handles a click on this card slot. Applies the click visual effect and sends the take card action to the server. Ignored if the card is not interactable.

    • handleCardEnter

      private void handleCardEnter()
      Handles the mouse entering this card slot. Applies the hover visual effect. Ignored if the card is not interactable.

    • handleCardExit

      private void handleCardExit()
      Handles the mouse exiting this card slot. Resets any active visual effect. Ignored if the card is not interactable.

    • setEffect

      public void setEffect(String style)
      Applies the given CSS style string to the card slot. Used by UIEffects to set hover and click effects.
      Parameters:
      style - the CSS style string to apply

    • resetEffect

      public void resetEffect()
      Removes any active CSS style from the card slot, restoring its default appearance.
